blocks.caption: Identifiers align labels, supplied outputs and reference.

result_of.sql:
WITH aligned AS (SELECT l.observation_id, l.cohort_id, l.actual_label, o.foundation_output, l.reference_output FROM labels l JOIN outputs o ON l.observation_id=o.observation_id AND l.cohort_id=o.cohort_id), counts AS (
 SELECT SUM(actual_label=1 AND foundation_output=1) AS TP,
 SUM(actual_label=0 AND foundation_output=1) AS FP,
 SUM(actual_label=1 AND foundation_output=0) AS FN,
 SUM(actual_label=0 AND foundation_output=0) AS TN FROM aligned),
 rates AS (SELECT *, FP+TN AS actual_negative_count, FN+TP AS actual_positive_count,
 1.0*FP/NULLIF(FP+TN,0) AS FPR, 1.0*FN/NULLIF(FN+TP,0) AS FNR FROM counts),
 costs AS (SELECT r.*, k.deployment_negative_probability, k.deployment_positive_probability, k.cost_FP, k.cost_FN,
 k.deployment_negative_probability*r.FPR*k.cost_FP + k.deployment_positive_probability*r.FNR*k.cost_FN AS expected_error_cost,
 k.expected_cost_bound FROM rates r CROSS JOIN contract k)
 SELECT *, expected_error_cost <= expected_cost_bound AS predictive_requirement_met FROM costs

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
labels = pd.read_csv('validation_scores.csv')
outputs = pd.read_csv('foundation_outputs.csv')
contract = pd.read_csv('acceptance_contract.csv')
assert np.array_equal(labels['observation_id'].to_numpy(),outputs['observation_id'].to_numpy())
assert np.array_equal(labels['cohort_id'].to_numpy(),outputs['cohort_id'].to_numpy())
assert outputs['output_kind'].eq('foundation-model').all()
y = labels['actual_label'].to_numpy()
yp = outputs['foundation_output'].to_numpy()
yb = labels['reference_output'].to_numpy()
tp_mask = (y == 1) & (yp == 1)
fp_mask = (y == 0) & (yp == 1)
fn_mask = (y == 1) & (yp == 0)
tn_mask = (y == 0) & (yp == 0)
# Complete the following learner analysis lines; retain all scaffold statements.
tp = None
fp = None
fn = None
tn = None
p = contract.iloc[0]
neg,pos = np.sum(y == 0),np.sum(y == 1)
fpr = fp/neg if neg and fp is not None else None
fnr = fn/pos if pos and fn is not None else None
cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*fnr*p.cost_FN if fpr is not None and fnr is not None else None
base_fpr = np.sum((y == 0)&(yb == 1))/neg if neg else None
base_fnr = np.sum((y == 1)&(yb == 0))/pos if pos else None
base_cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*base_fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*base_fnr*p.cost_FN if base_fpr is not None and base_fnr is not None else None
result = {'aligned':True,'cohort':labels.iloc[0].cohort_id,'counts':{'TP':tp,'FP':fp,'FN':fn,'TN':tn},'FPR':fpr,'FNR':fnr,'expected_error_cost':cost,'baseline_FPR':base_fpr,'baseline_FNR':base_fnr,'baseline_expected_error_cost':base_cost,'verdict':'predictive acceptance' if cost is not None and cost <= p.expected_cost_bound else 'no predictive acceptance','limitation':'Supplied foundation-model outputs on this validation cohort only; this is not training, application construction or evidence of universal suitability. Operating evidence remains separate.'}

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
labels = pd.read_csv('validation_scores.csv')
outputs = pd.read_csv('foundation_outputs.csv')
contract = pd.read_csv('acceptance_contract.csv')
assert np.array_equal(labels['observation_id'].to_numpy(),outputs['observation_id'].to_numpy())
assert np.array_equal(labels['cohort_id'].to_numpy(),outputs['cohort_id'].to_numpy())
assert outputs['output_kind'].eq('foundation-model').all()
y = labels['actual_label'].to_numpy()
yp = outputs['foundation_output'].to_numpy()
yb = labels['reference_output'].to_numpy()
tp_mask = (y == 1) & (yp == 1)
fp_mask = (y == 0) & (yp == 1)
fn_mask = (y == 1) & (yp == 0)
tn_mask = (y == 0) & (yp == 0)
tp = np.sum(tp_mask)
fp = np.sum(fp_mask)
fn = np.sum(fn_mask)
tn = np.sum(tn_mask)
p = contract.iloc[0]
neg,pos = np.sum(y == 0),np.sum(y == 1)
fpr = fp/neg if neg and fp is not None else None
fnr = fn/pos if pos and fn is not None else None
cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*fnr*p.cost_FN if fpr is not None and fnr is not None else None
base_fpr = np.sum((y == 0)&(yb == 1))/neg if neg else None
base_fnr = np.sum((y == 1)&(yb == 0))/pos if pos else None
base_cost = p.deployment_negative_probability*base_fpr*p.cost_FP+p.deployment_positive_probability*base_fnr*p.cost_FN if base_fpr is not None and base_fnr is not None else None
result = {'aligned':True,'cohort':labels.iloc[0].cohort_id,'counts':{'TP':tp,'FP':fp,'FN':fn,'TN':tn},'FPR':fpr,'FNR':fnr,'expected_error_cost':cost,'baseline_FPR':base_fpr,'baseline_FNR':base_fnr,'baseline_expected_error_cost':base_cost,'verdict':'predictive acceptance' if cost is not None and cost <= p.expected_cost_bound else 'no predictive acceptance','limitation':'Supplied foundation-model outputs on this validation cohort only; this is not training, application construction or evidence of universal suitability. Operating evidence remains separate.'}
